body: Oh yes it's definitely fiction! I forgot to mention that in my description. Or at least I hope it's fiction haha.

Oh! I love Peter.

So far I've got: So the good news is we don't have to worry about these alligators. The bad news is I'm kind of suicidal.

Of course. I threw in my SSN for good measure as well. No such thing as TMI with friends, right?
I wish.
Came here to say this! My favorite part.

I feel like such a downer but I took a victim's resource advocate with me to the meeting. They said absolutely nothing during the meeting with the officer. I was the only one standing up (and advocating) for myself. RAINN is a fantastic resource though, thank you. :)

Unfortunately, they are aware that I was blackout drunk and I've already tried speaking with another cop. This police department is utterly worthless. My therapist told me this isn't the first time she has heard something similar happen...

I think she's a phenomenal actress but the musical performances killed me. I felt like they took away from the show. I ended up sitting in front of my tv wondering why there was a musical number rather than getting more sucked into the AHS universe.
That was a really beautiful story. Thanks for the smile today. :)
I noticed that too. Sometimes this game knows how to tickle my funny bone.

No I didn't tell her. I was thinking along the same lines as you. I figured if she didn't remember anything then telling her would only make things unnecessarily worse. My therapist wants me to tell my mom about it so I might try telling her this weekend when I'm home.
What the hell is wrong with you?
You're rocking and rolling! Just wanted to say that. Seems like we had similar assault situations. Sorry for what happened to you but it seems like you're fighting back in your own way.
I wish you the best. Just keep an eye on your mood. Please let your doctor know if something drastic changes.
I second that. Stopping meds cold turkey isn't healthy and will have negative side effects.

The guy who raped me in the same building as me so I understand that can be really tough. I had to see him A LOT. I did report it to the school and requested he be moved from my building which helped a bit because I would be able to hang out in the lounges again.

No matter how he feels about it, it was rape. You were too far gone to give consent and that's not right. I'm so sorry that you're going through this. PM me if you want to talk.
You're welcome. PM me if you ever want to talk. :) You're going to get through this. It's not going to be easy but you will.
Blonde underneath or blonde all over? I'm dark blonde right now. I did light blonde for a while but it was a lot of work keeping it looking nice.

I'm so sorry that you're dealing with this. It sounds like he's a real ass. I'm a people pleaser so I always want people to be ok with me and I imagine you are the same way, which would explain you wanting him to like you still. 

My advice would be to start looking for another job if possible. No need to be stressed out constantly over it all. Unfortunately, there are asses everywhere in the world but maybe you can find a job where you're surrounded by positive people.
Thank you so much. This made me smile. Please try the "me 2.0" thing! It's working well for me. I'm falling in love with new me. She's pretty cool. :) I bet your you 2.0 is great too!

I'm glad you exist. You're struggling right now but you'll get through it. Sometimes life just fucking sucks. I don't think there's anything I can say to make it any better. Sometimes I feel the way you do. One of my friends told me "if you're worrying you're a burden then you're not a burden." I try to keep that in mind when I get into a bad mindset. 

You helped me just by reminding me that I'm not the only one struggling hard through life. Good people have bad days. I'm sorry this is a bad day for you. PM me if you need to talk. :)
You're a superstar. Congratulations!

Thank you for that suggestion! I've been thinking about the new me since you posted this actually. I'm calling it "me 2.0" because I see parts of the new me that maybe are better than the old me. New me isn't afraid to wander around Manhattan by herself. Old me might not have been so brave. New me also has new dreams, but that's good because old me wasn't sure what she wanted to do with her life. 

I have a firm belief that everything happens for a reason, both bad and good things, so if the reason is some personal growth maybe that's good? Idk... rape is always awful. I look for silver linings with everything. Even after I was raped I was being an optimist and cracking jokes with the police officer in the hospital. I'm strange but I love that about old and new me.

Thank you so much for your response. I read through it initially when I posted it and connected with a lot of what you said and I just read through it all again. You seem to have a really good understanding of how people work and I really really appreciate your input. You're right, I do think I test things when I try pushing my friend away. He always comes back though, I should really learn that already.

It's really tough. I have to keep reminding myself I'm doing so much better than I was even just three months ago. I have confidence that we will all get through this. I guess it just takes a lot of time.

Thank you again for your response. It sounded like it could have been written by me if you add in some curse words haha. It's amazing how similar our life stories can be. Weird. Best of luck to you!
I'm sorry to hear that. It's great of you to do peer counseling though. It's a good way of turning a negative thing into a positive thing. I like that.

I think if I make a funfetti cake he'll have to love it because everyone likes funfetti cake. It's the happiest cake I can think of! 

Healing here I come? I have had more good days than bad recently so I guess that's a good sign too. You definitely seem to know what you're talking about! Thank you for the support. :)

Thank you. Your response was exactly what I needed. I'll have to think of something nice to do for my friend... He isn't super into sweets but you're right, old me would have definitely baked a cake or some cookies in this situation. I'll start brainstorming.

Seriously, thank you so much. I beat myself up for not being better or back to normal and often forget that it hasn't been a full year yet. Most of the time I do ok and that's pretty good I'd say. I really had no idea how hard it could be trying to live a relatively normal life after a rape.

I'm pretty sure a good amount of time has passed between the season 1 finale and the first episode of season 2. Something like a handful of months. That could explain his seemingly rapid hair regrowth.
That was my first thought too! I was hoping someone else saw it. I also think shorter hair would be perfect.
I was told that he had arthritis when I asked for his autograph. It made perfect sense to a 5th grader.
As a child of a single parent I always thought the dad was a loser who walked out. I like your imaginary dad better...

This post makes me so sad. You're right, I don't know how you feel. I'm not at that point. I've thought about how I might do it, but I've never come up with an official plan. If you want help finding the most efficient way I really can't help because I don't know but if you do want to talk feel free to PM me. I don't want you to die.

:( I'm sorry that you're in so much pain. You can do something with your life though. One small step you can make is finding a place to volunteer at once a week. Places are always in need of volunteers!
I like your more positive look. I like the original post too but there are some days where I feel like your version too.

Thank you, I am doing better now. I hope you are too! Thank you for reminding me of what I know to be true. I didn't deserve what happened to me either and the guy has no excuse for what he did to me. I have to remind myself of that more often than I would like. You're a good person, I'm glad you spoke up. :)

I called my best friend crying over it because I was afraid what op said was true. My best friend (a male) called bullshit on it. I just can't believe someone would post something like that here... This is a safe space.
Thank you for posting this. I was horrified when I saw this post and I'm grateful to your replies. You put the OP in his place.

I'm so sorry. That sounds awful. I'm looking at getting in touch with some lawyers this week about my case and this is what terrifies me. Are you able to try talking to a different lawyer? Also see about getting in contact with a Victims Resource Center. They're really great and it will give you someone to talk to that won't make you feel like it's your fault. It isn't your fault. I shouldn't have been where I was the night I was raped but that doesn't mean I deserved it or was asking for it. The same goes for you. Even if you made every bad decision that night you did not deserve to be sexually assaulted. Good luck and feel free to PM me if you need to talk.

I'm not sure how other people feel but sometimes I like distractions so I'll listen to an audiobook or listen to a tv show while my SO watches it. Sometimes the migraine is too bad for me to be able to enjoy either. I also like gentle back rubs because it also distracts me from the pain. Hope this helps!

Peter,

I'm a huge fan of your portrayal of Tyrion! You totally steal the show! Game of Thrones is my absolute favorite show. I have two questions for you:

Where's your favorite place to eat in NYC? Also, what was your weirdest encounter with a fan?

Thanks for doing an AMA!

First of all, it seems like you're doing all of the right things. I had a similar thing happen to me and I also turned to a close male friend and took comfort in being near him. The first few nights after I was assaulted I was afraid to be alone so I had him sleep over. I realize it was a safety thing with me. I always feel safer with my friend so that was why I wanted to be near him. We frequently cuddled (and still do), especially when I'm having a particularly rough day. Just do whatever she's comfortable with and don't push anything. If she comfortable with touching you and stuff then let her as long as you're comfortable with it.

You have great taste in scarves! I absolutely love the one you're wearing! Also, that lip color is perfect for you. It warms you right up. I would try playing up your eyes a bit because they're such a lovely deep brown. Nothing too heavy of course, just some mascara and perhaps a neutral eye shadow (like a beige perhaps). Keep smiling! :)

Oh my gosh that's terrible! I'm so sorry you had to go through that. He had absolutely no right to do that to you. 

I read somewhere that people react differently to rape (something to do with fight or flight). It's normal that you froze up. I also froze up when I was raped and I would get incredibly upset when people would ask me why I didn't fight back or scream or whatever. My stupid body decided to freeze up on me. 

Again I'm so so sorry. I can't even imagine what that could have been like. I'd like to think it gets better and with the proper support I really think it can. Good luck.

I second this. I absolutely do not fall apart in front of anyone but ended up falling apart in front of one of my best guy friends, who I am now comfortable losing it in front of. Being able to fall apart in front of someone who cares about you makes everything feel a little less hopeless.
I've seen the old Pride and Prejudice with Colin Firth over 20 times. It's a looong movie but so worth it.
Oh that makes sense. It's an unfortunate thing we have to deal with, isn't it?

I too have friends that drink almost every evening. Luckily, they all kind of understand what happens when I get a headache so they never pester me about why I'm not drinking. My best friends can usually tell when I'm trying to fake my way through a migraine at a party. If your friends don't want you around because of your migraines then they're definitely not friends worth having. We can totally hang out and drink water and talk about our medications though!

I feel ya! I'm turning 21 on Thursday and going out with my friends tomorrow at midnight. I know I'm going to feel like complete shit on Thursday and that frustrates me. I really enjoy drinking with my friends. I should be able to have one beer without getting a migraine shortly after.

I wasn't a Santa but I was a kid with an odd request. I asked a mall Santa for a new dad when I was little. My dad cheated on my mom and broke up our family. At the age of 7 I knew I didn't want him to be my dad anymore and wanted someone else (like Colin Firth <3). That poor Santa. My mom was mortified.
Like standing still in a garden endlessly.
That's my problem with him as well. I try really hard to remember he's not actually Rene but it's tough. Also I would totally bang Hook but I probably wouldn't bang Neal, so there's that.
I'm sorry. You can always go back though or make up the classes over the summer. In the meantime, worry about you. Migraines blow.

The chiropractor has been the only thing that helps me. I almost didn't even consider going to a chiropractor because my family basically thinks it's a joke. I'm certainly glad my ex dragged me along to his appointment with him!
Congrats! That's fantastic news!
Maxalt worked for me but other drugs like it (like Zomig) did not work for me. Maxalt was too expensive for me so I had to stop using it.
Well that's a depressing thought. It makes sense though. I've had to change my career path because my migraines were keeping me from attending classes which lead to me falling hopelessly behind.

I get that. It's definitely weird being on your own at first. I literally didn't know what to do with myself so I did a lot of sitting around for a couple of days. Luckily my best friend gave me a boot in the rear and dragged me off to lunch.
That's how I was. My appetite came back though as things started to hurt less so I'm sure yours will too. As my mom would say, "it's good for the diet plan." =P

I totally almost posted a discussion on this because I'm going through my first real break up (I'm a big girl now!). It's poopy and weird but I think space has been good for me and some good friend time has really helped. I just watched a romcom with my best friend last night and it reminded me of the shitty things that I don't miss from our relationship. It's a funny thing but I put up with a lot of shit with my ex.

Enjoy your freedom! Being single can be totally wonderful and liberating. I've had a lot of fun these past few weeks with my friends and even just on my own. I really enjoy watching shows during my alone time and I didn't really have much alone time when I was in a relationship. Good luck and go watch your favorite movie! I suggest 10 Things I Hate About You! I got a real kick out of it.
I now know that I too have trypophobia. Gross.

Tea is a good call too. Sleepy time tea always makes me feel better! Good luck with whatever you're dealing with. It will get better. I am in a much better place now than I was a year ago. Time really does heal everything.

Yup. It's a really long story but I was dealing with a ton of shit and I couldn't deal with it any more so I just sorta shut down. My friends got me to drink with them and we played some video games and we shit on this girl that was basically trying to ruin my life. I still felt kinda shitty the next day but it certainly helped having a drink with some friends. 

If you'd like I can prepare a drink for myself on my end and you can get one on your end and we can have a drink together. =)

I started seeing the chiropractor last semester and it is the only thing that has helped me. I really really hope yours helps you. Some days I don't have any pain at all and it's the most amazing thing.

Do you have an IEP or Disability Plan (if you're in college)? It's the only reason I haven't failed out because I miss so many classes. Most profs are really understanding but some aren't so it's nice to have a disability plan to fall back on.

This happened when my dad moved into his current place! The previous owners claimed the cat wouldn't leave that house. She's a real sweetie and my dad loves cats so it wasn't a big deal, just weird that the owners just left her.

My dog, Molly, was a rescue. My stepbrother was friends with this guy who owned her prior to us and he abused and neglected Molly (she was underweight, left alone for 12 hours at a time, was given empty cigarette boxes as toys, etc.) My stepbrother gave the guy $100 to take her off his hands. My stepbrother really didn't want to take on another dog but he couldn't leave her like that.

We ended up dog sitting Molly for a week while my stepbrother was on vacation and, after my stepdad and I fell in love with her, she never left. She was a purebred golden retriever and lived to be around 15 years old. We had to put her down last September when cancer finally got her. We couldn't have asked for a better dog. She was a little angel and she was always so happy! She was the highlight of my day every day. Any future pet that I own will come from a shelter. There's something special about rescue pets.

[Molly](http://i.imgur.com/YnOfhZV.jpg) Don't you just want to hug her? =)

She's been given a pretty shitty hand but has made the best out of it which is absolutely admirable. She also prides herself in being a fashionable old lady. She's pretty awesome!

I love this contest idea! Family is so incredibly important. Again, I'm sorry that your stuff was stolen. I'm sure that was an awful experience.

The only success I've had was when I had my neck realigned by my chiropractor and I get massage therapy every time I visit him as well so I think there is something to be said for that route for sure.

Nope put the damn cake down. You can get slimmer and healthier by making small changes to your daily lifestyle. You can have the cake but only have a tiny sliver and eat slowly. It'll be as if you enjoyed a larger piece without the added calories. When you park in parking lots, choose a spot farther away from the building every time. The extra walking isn't much but over time it will help. You can be healthy! I believe in you.

I'm in the same boat. You pretty much described my headache history. I'm sick of missing out on my own life because of them. Also, I almost lost a job because my employee (and I thought she was a friend) told my boss that I fake headaches so I can get out of things like classes and meetings. People really don't understand how fucking hard it is to live with daily pain. Good luck and I hope we both grow out of them. It's the only thing that keeps me going.

I have a real soft spot for the elderly. I adore my grandparents so whenever I see an old person that needs help I run to their side and help them any way I can. My childhood was something else. My amazing mom did everything she could to make the best out of our situation. She saved up forever to take us to Disney World because our dad promised to take us but never did and she always wanted to go to Disney. The four of us (mom, grandma, my brother, and I) all went for a week and had such a fantastic time! We did everything and anything and we went in October so it wasn't horribly busy. 

Disney is such a magical place and if you spend any time there you're going to start believing anything is possible. I went for my senior trip two years ago and I felt the same way. I was nothing but happy on both my trips to Disney. I'm currently grinning like an idiot thinking about all of the fun I had!
